newsitem.title: GERMANY: Cockerill Sambre may buy rest of Eko Stahl.
newsitem.headline: Cockerill Sambre may buy rest of Eko Stahl.

text.p: Belgian steel maker Cockerill Sambre SA is interested in buying the remaining 40 percent of east German steel maker Eko Stahl GmbH that it does not already own, German authorities said on Friday.
BvS, the successor to the agency that was charged with privatising east German companies and owns the 40 percent stake, said Cockerill was interested in buying the stake in the near future.

Cockerill Sambre wants to run Eko Stahl as an integrated in its corporate strategy, BvS said. Eko Stahl planned to open a modernised hot rolled steel plant next Tuesday, with German chancellor Helmut Kohl participating in the ceremony.
Eko Stahl has said it expected to lose 100 million marks ($55.8 million) this year, break even in 1998 and return to profitability in 1999. BvS was expected to cover the 1997 loss.
BvS said 1.13 bilion marks have been invested to make Eko Stahl competitive, including 275 million marks from the agency and 385 million marks from the state of Brandenburg.
